answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks using Proof of Burn registration. An agent must destroy native tokens at an unspendable address, generating a verifiable receipt that acts as a bridge to network routing privileges. Because adversaries cannot forge valid receipts, creating a hollow identity requires forfeiting scarce, non-recoverable capital. However, this continuous financial burn imposes a regressive operational cost that disproportionately penalizes honest micro-agents.
